name: Maia
tagline: A reusable methane rocket for Kourou: first flight now set for the second half of 2027
description: Maia is the rocket of MaiaSpace, a subsidiary of ArianeGroup: 50 m tall and 3.5 m wide, with three Prometheus engines in the first stage and one in the second, burning methane and liquid oxygen. It is meant to lift 500 kg when reusable and 1,500 kg when expended, or 2,500 kg with the Colibri kick stage (Wikipedia figures). It will fly from the former Soyuz pad (ELS) in Kourou; the occupancy agreement was signed on 2026-02-24. On 2026-07-29 MaiaSpace dropped its planned suborbital test and will go straight to orbit, with a first flight in the second half of 2027. That date was the second half of 2026 in June 2025.
best_known_for: ArianeGroup subsidiary's reusable methane rocket for Kourou; first flight now set for the second half of 2027
